provider_receipt.summary: Review found unsupported completion and four named defects: (1) src/lib.rs:56-88 MemoryStore::store serializes each MemoryRecord and immediately discards it, so scan_vault provides no persistent Mnemosyne storage or durable ingestion; (2) src/lib.rs:13-25 requires legacy fields and numeric confidence, while docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:71-94 specifies authority, privacy, provenance, review, and string-valued confidence fields, so contract-compliant notes cannot be ingested and required classification is not enforced; (3) src/lib.rs:110-114 silently discards WalkDir traversal errors, allowing incomplete scans to be reported as successful; (4) src/lib.rs:184-192 permits absolute and parent-directory wikilinks to resolve outside the private vault boundary. The supplied verification receipt establishes only a clean tree and source inspection, not functional or security verification of these behaviors. No files were modified and no checks were rerun.
